topRisks: Socket.IO identification accepts client-supplied userId without verification (impersonation)
Logout route is unreachable (defined inside login catch block)
No rate limiting, no helmet, no CSRF protection anywhere
Stored XSS risk: message/email bodies never sanitized
NoSQL injection risk in analytics sortBy param
Memory leaks possible in Chat / notification hooks

security.title: Hardcoded admin email and password in source
security.description: Admin email 'admin@kickstream.com' and password 'admin123' are hardcoded and committed to version control. Trivially brute-forceable and exposed in repo.
security.recommendation: Read ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD from env; require strong password; or prompt interactively. Refuse to run if admin already exists unless --force is passed.

security.title: Logs full request headers and cookies in /api/ably-token
security.description: console.log of req.headers and req.headers.cookie leaks JWT tokens and other secrets to logs (Railway, file system, log aggregators).
security.recommendation: Remove header/cookie logging. Use a structured logger (winston/pino) with redaction of Authorization/Cookie/Set-Cookie.

security.title: POST /api/admin/messages is unauthenticated
security.description: No authMiddleware on the inbound message endpoint. Any anonymous client can post messages, trigger admin notifications, send emails, and pollute analytics.
security.recommendation: Either require authMiddleware, or move to a dedicated /api/contact endpoint protected by rate limiting + CAPTCHA + email-format validation + body length cap.

security.title: POST /api/analytics/track is fully open
security.description: No auth, no rate limit, accepts arbitrary email/userId/ip/country from the client. Allows data poisoning, user enumeration, and bogus analytics injection.
security.recommendation: Require authentication for identified analytics; derive IP server-side from req.ip; rate-limit per IP; whitelist event names; cap payload size.

security.title: Socket.IO 'identify' trusts client-supplied userId
security.description: Any connected client can emit identify with any userId and start receiving that user's notifications. Full impersonation primitive.
security.recommendation: Use Socket.IO auth middleware: read JWT from handshake (cookie or auth payload), verify it, and set socket.data.userId server-side. Ignore client-sent identify payloads.

security.title: Logout route is defined inside login handler (dead code)
security.description: router.post('/logout', ...) is declared inside the try block of the login handler, so it is only registered after a successful login call, on every login, leading to duplicate handlers or never being registered.
security.recommendation: Move router.post('/logout', ...) to module scope, after the login route closes.

security.title: Message body and senderEmail are stored and rendered unsanitized
security.description: Raw HTML/JS can be stored and later rendered in admin UI, enabling stored XSS against the admin account.
security.recommendation: Validate senderEmail with validator.isEmail; cap body length (e.g. 5000); sanitize HTML with the 'xss' library or strip HTML; escape on render in React.

security.title: No validation of email/password/username strength
security.description: Accepts any email, any password (including empty after trim), no username constraints, no rate limiting. Enables credential stuffing, weak accounts, enumeration via timing.
security.recommendation: Add validator.isEmail, enforce min 8-12 chars + complexity, length-limit username, add express-rate-limit on /login and /register, return constant-time generic error for bad credentials.

security.title: Unbounded embedded messages array
security.description: messages is an embedded array with no cap. Documents can approach the 16MB MongoDB limit and cause the OOM crashes already observed.
security.recommendation: Move messages into a separate collection with an index on { conversationId, createdAt }, OR enforce a hard cap (e.g. 200) and archive older messages.

security.title: Unvalidated sort field used directly in Mongo query
security.description: req.query.sortBy is plugged into a sort object without a whitelist, allowing operator injection in some Mongo configurations.
security.recommendation: Whitelist allowed sort fields (e.g. ['lastVisit','totalVisits','pagesViewed']) and reject anything else.

security.title: limit query param has no upper bound
security.description: parseInt(req.query.limit) || 25 with no Math.min cap lets a caller request ?limit=10000000 and force the server to OOM.
security.recommendation: const limit = Math.min(parseInt(req.query.limit) || 25, 100); apply uniformly.

security.title: No helmet, no rate limiting, no CSRF strategy
security.description: Server is missing baseline hardening middleware. Exposed to clickjacking, MIME sniffing, and brute force.
security.recommendation: app.use(helmet()); add express-rate-limit globally and tighter limits on /api/auth/*; rely on SameSite=None+Strict origin allowlist for CSRF or add csurf for state-changing endpoints.

security.title: No validation of 'to' recipient and no try/catch
security.description: An invalid or attacker-controlled 'to' value can be passed through; failures bubble up as unhandled rejections.
security.recommendation: Validate with validator.isEmail; wrap sendMail in try/catch; sanitize subject (strip CR/LF to prevent header injection).

security.title: Socket.IO CORS falls back to '*'
security.description: origin: process.env.CLIENT_URL || '*' — if CLIENT_URL is unset, any origin can connect.
security.recommendation: Fail fast at boot if CLIENT_URL is missing; never fall back to '*'.

security.title: ObjectId params not validated
security.description: Invalid IDs throw 500 instead of 400; potential for query-shape abuse.
security.recommendation: if (!mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(req.params.userId)) return res.status(400).

security.title: No retention policy or delete endpoint
security.description: Stores IP/country/email indefinitely without consent flow or DELETE endpoint. Violates GDPR Art. 17 if EU users are involved.
security.recommendation: Add TTL index on createdAt; provide DELETE /api/user/analytics; add cookie/consent banner; minimize PII.

security.title: Exports full PII without masking or audit log
security.description: Anyone with admin can download full email/IP/country dataset, no audit trail.
security.recommendation: Mask emails, log every export with admin id+timestamp+row count, require re-auth or 2FA for export.

security.title: Accepts JWT from arbitrary header in addition to cookie
security.description: Allows bypassing SameSite cookie protections via custom header from a malicious origin if CORS is misconfigured.
security.recommendation: Drop the x-auth-token fallback unless explicitly needed; rely on HttpOnly cookie.

security.title: Password field not excluded by default
security.description: Forgetting .select('-password') in a future query will leak hashes.
security.recommendation: Set password field to select:false in schema and add toJSON transform to strip it.

qualityAndPerformance.title: N+1 query when populating participants in /conversations
qualityAndPerformance.recommendation: Use a single $lookup stage inside the aggregation instead of per-doc User.find.

qualityAndPerformance.title: Analytics-update logic duplicated between /messages and /analytics/track
qualityAndPerformance.recommendation: Extract into a shared upsertAnalytics(query, patch) helper.

qualityAndPerformance.title: Missing indexes on hot query fields
qualityAndPerformance.recommendation: Add indexes: Conversation { participants:1, lastUpdated:-1 }, Message { timestamp:-1, senderEmail:1 }, UserAnalytics { email:1 }, { lastVisit:-1 }.

qualityAndPerformance.title: Loads entire collection into memory
qualityAndPerformance.recommendation: Stream with cursor() or paginate in batches of 500.

qualityAndPerformance.title: No graceful shutdown
qualityAndPerformance.recommendation: Handle SIGTERM/SIGINT: close http server, io.close(), mongoose.disconnect().

qualityAndPerformance.title: MongoDB connection failure is non-fatal
qualityAndPerformance.recommendation: process.exit(1) on initial connection error so the orchestrator restarts.

incompleteFeatures.title: Admin notification bell backend
incompleteFeatures.description: Notification model exists but no REST endpoint to list/mark-read user-facing notifications.

incompleteFeatures.title: Conversation pagination cursor
incompleteFeatures.description: Only last-N slice is returned; no 'load older' cursor parameter, so the UI cannot scroll back.

incompleteFeatures.title: Account lifecycle
incompleteFeatures.description: No email verification, no password reset, no account deletion endpoints.

incompleteFeatures.title: Tests
incompleteFeatures.description: No unit, integration, or contract tests anywhere in backend/.

incompleteFeatures.title: Logging / observability
incompleteFeatures.description: No structured logger, no request log middleware (morgan), no error reporter (Sentry).

security.title: Chat messages rendered without explicit sanitization
security.description: Text comes from server and is rendered as-is. React escapes text nodes, but any future use of dangerouslySetInnerHTML or attribute interpolation would be exploitable, and stored XSS in message bodies will surface in the admin UI.
security.recommendation: Sanitize with DOMPurify at the boundary, cap message length, verify senderId before treating a message as 'self'.

security.title: No client-side email/password validation
security.recommendation: Validate format and strength before submit; show inline errors; disable button on invalid input.

security.title: Unbounded contact form submission
security.recommendation: Validate email, cap body, debounce submit, show server-side rate-limit errors.

security.title: Admin pages render before verifying user.isAdmin
security.recommendation: Add a route guard that redirects non-admins; do not depend solely on backend response.

security.title: Socket.io identifies user by client-supplied user.id
security.recommendation: Pass JWT via socket auth handshake; verify server-side; do not emit 'identify'.

security.title: Legacy demo auth flow still present
security.recommendation: Remove or hard-disable; always route through backend /api/auth/login.

security.title: Sends raw email/username to analytics endpoint
security.recommendation: Send hashed userId only; provide opt-out; respect Do Not Track.

security.title: No Content-Security-Policy meta tag and no SRI for external assets
security.recommendation: Add CSP via response headers (or meta), add integrity attributes to <link>/<script> from CDNs.

security.title: Backend base URL exposed as VITE_API_URL
security.description: Not a secret, but allows attackers to enumerate backend directly bypassing any frontend protections.
security.recommendation: Front the API with a same-origin reverse proxy (Vercel rewrites) and drop VITE_API_URL from the bundle.

qualityAndBugs.title: Message list keyed by array index
Ably channels not explicitly unsubscribed before client close
qualityAndBugs.recommendation: Call userChannel.unsubscribe() in cleanup before ablyRef.current.close().

qualityAndBugs.title: Interval may be created in both try and catch branches
qualityAndBugs.recommendation: Create the interval once, outside try/catch; store id in a ref and clear in cleanup.

qualityAndBugs.title: No AbortController on fetch in useEffect
qualityAndBugs.recommendation: Cancel in-flight requests on unmount to avoid setState-after-unmount warnings.

qualityAndBugs.title: No pagination — renders entire analytics dataset
qualityAndBugs.recommendation: Paginate, sort and filter server-side; consider react-window for the visible table.

qualityAndBugs.title: Notification callback always opens widget even if already open
qualityAndBugs.recommendation: setOpen(prev => prev || true) and only invoke a sound/badge update if already open.

qualityAndBugs.title: No React ErrorBoundary
qualityAndBugs.recommendation: Wrap App with an ErrorBoundary that logs to Sentry and shows a recovery UI.

qualityAndBugs.title: Massive inline-style objects instead of Tailwind classes
qualityAndBugs.recommendation: Migrate to Tailwind utility classes / CSS modules; extract a small design-tokens module.

qualityAndBugs.title: Large unoptimized MP4 backgrounds loaded eagerly
qualityAndBugs.recommendation: Provide 720p/1080p WebM+MP4, use preload='metadata', lazy mount on viewport intersection, prefer poster image on mobile.

qualityAndBugs.title: socket.io-client imported dynamically per mount
qualityAndBugs.recommendation: Create a singleton socket module imported statically; share across hooks.

qualityAndBugs.title: Polls every 60s indefinitely with no backoff
qualityAndBugs.recommendation: Exponential backoff on failures; pause when tab is hidden (document.visibilityState).

qualityAndBugs.title: Global document click listener can spam the analytics endpoint
qualityAndBugs.recommendation: Debounce and only track elements with data-track attribute.

qualityAndBugs.title: console.log / console.warn left in production code
qualityAndBugs.recommendation: Strip in build (vite-plugin-remove-console) or guard with import.meta.env.DEV.

incompleteFeatures.title: Notification bell + dropdown
incompleteFeatures.description: Badge count exists but no list view, no mark-as-read, no per-notification navigation.

incompleteFeatures.title: End-to-end tests
incompleteFeatures.description: No Cypress/Playwright tests. Critical flows (login, send message, admin reply) are untested.

incompleteFeatures.title: Accessibility
incompleteFeatures.description: Missing alt text on images, missing label/htmlFor associations, icon-only buttons missing aria-label, no focus trap in modals.

incompleteFeatures.title: Error boundaries / global error UI
incompleteFeatures.description: App crashes to blank screen on any render error.

incompleteFeatures.title: Loading & rate-limit UX
incompleteFeatures.description: No unified spinner; 429 responses aren't surfaced to the user.

deploymentAndConfig.title: Secrets risk if backend/.env was ever committed
deploymentAndConfig.recommendation: Confirm backend/.env is in .gitignore and was purged from git history with git filter-repo; rotate JWT_SECRET, ABLY_API_KEY, MONGO_URI, SMTP creds.

deploymentAndConfig.title: No security headers at the edge
deploymentAndConfig.recommendation: Add Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy and CSP via Vercel headers.

deploymentAndConfig.title: Single replica on low memory tier crashes under load
deploymentAndConfig.recommendation: Add health check + autorestart, increase memory, or move chat to a managed realtime (Ably-only, no socket.io duplication).

immediate: Move /api/auth/logout out of the login catch block.
Add authMiddleware to POST /api/admin/messages and POST /api/analytics/track (or rate-limit + CAPTCHA).
Verify JWT in Socket.IO handshake; ignore client-sent identify.
shortTerm: Add helmet, express-rate-limit, and input validation (validator / zod) across all routes.
Whitelist sort fields and cap pagination limits.
Sanitize message/email bodies with the 'xss' library.
Add ErrorBoundary, AbortController on fetches, stable keys in Chat list.
mediumTerm: Move Conversation.messages to its own collection with proper indexes and pagination cursor.
Implement password reset, email verification, account deletion (GDPR).
Add structured logging (pino) + Sentry on FE and BE.
Add Cypress E2E tests for auth, chat, admin reply.
Optimize hero/auth videos (WebM, lazy mount, poster).
